description: Companies newly incorporated (Hong Kong local) or newly registered/re-domiciled (non-Hong Kong) on the Companies Registry since a given date — the official weekly open-data feed via data.gov.hk (新註冊/新成立公司, since 2024-12-30). Returns each company's BR number, English/Chinese name, type, and incorporation-or-registration date, most recent first. The feed has roughly a 1-week publication lag, so a `since` newer than the latest published week returns zero rows with a `data_lag_note` explaining it — that is lag, not "no new companies". Use for "new Hong Kong companies this week", "companies incorporated in HK since <date>".

since.description: Only include companies incorporated/registered on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: 7 days before the latest published week.

type.description: Restrict to Hong Kong local companies ("local") or non-Hong Kong companies ("non_hk"). Omit for both.

name: hk_new_companies
title: Hk New Companies
